role: Defines PipelineError (HRV analysis failure categories with log descriptions) and the attempt/sleepQuietly helpers that replace try? with a logged swallow.
types: PipelineError: enum (Error, LocalizedError) — analysis pipeline failure kinds

units.does: Returns a short English description per PipelineError case with the session UUID's first 8 chars.
units.entry: LocalizedError witness; read via error.localizedDescription in HRVAnalysisPipeline+Metrics.swift:134

flags.text: PipelineError.noRecoveryWindow is never constructed anywhere in the repo (its only occurrence is this case), so this description is unreachable.

healthKitFetchFailed's description discards the associated `underlying` error, and logPipelineError logs only error.localizedDescription, so a HealthKit daytime-resting-HR fetch failure is logged as 'Apple Health daytimeRestingHR failed …' with no reason (auth denied, protected data, etc.).

units.does: Runs a throwing closure, returning its value or nil; on throw logs '[operation] failed: …' at .warning attributed to the caller.

branches.effect: logs at .warning (lands in Recent Problems) and returns nil

units.does: Awaits Task.sleep(nanoseconds:); on cancellation logs '[Sleep] interrupted during <context>' at .info and returns normally.

branches.effect: logged, swallowed; caller continues as if the sleep completed
